## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Include an example when useful.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. Identify any provider contracts that could
not run locally and the CI job that covers them.

## Upgrade impact

Note API/configuration changes, optional dependencies, migrations and retained
data. For documentation-only changes, say so.

- [ ] Module ownership, toggles and removal guidance remain consistent.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass; dependency changes include the lockfile and audit.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens or customer data are included in the diff or examples.
